cells.label: Baseline: all 16 cells 0, no pools, no contract balances

cells.note: 15/15 pairwise colour comparisons distinct, read from on-chain circuit calls

cells.label: OwnerN deposits S1 6 -> AA_A
cells.points: Manager balances (AA_A S1 0->6) + that colour's pooled coin; the OTHER shielded pool byte-identical
cells.note: A SINGLE wallet-balanced call: the Manager declares the receive and the depositor's wallet supplies the input, so sender spend and Manager receive share one transaction by construction.

cells.label: OwnerN deposits U1 5 -> AA_A
cells.points: Manager balances (AA_A U1 0->5) + the ledger kernel's unshielded balance for U1
cells.note: A SINGLE wallet-balanced call: the Manager declares the receive and the depositor's wallet supplies the input, so sender spend and Manager receive share one transaction by construction.

cells.note: The spec's "pool UNCHANGED (no token op)" row, asserted over the whole custody surface rather than one colour.

cells.label: internal transfer U2 2: AA_B -> AA_A (no token operation)

cells.note: The spec's "pool UNCHANGED (no token op)" row, asserted over the whole custody surface rather than one colour.

cells.label: AA_B withdraws S1 3 -> OwnerM

cells.label: AA_A withdraws U2 2 -> OwnerN
cells.points: Manager balances (AA_A U2 2->0) + the ledger kernel's U2 balance 5->3; OwnerN observer wallet AND indexer reconstruction both 0->2; ledgerU1 unchanged at 5

cells.label: M1 mixed-colour probe: OwnerM deposits S2 2 AND U2 2 to AA_B in ONE transaction
cells.points: ONE transaction id carries BOTH effects: S2 pool 6->8 (merge) with AA_B S2 6->8, AND the ledger kernel U2 balance 3->5 with AA_B U2 3->5
cells.note: D-102 resolved to: sdk-scoped batch (one transaction, one segment per call, state threaded). one-intent (two same-contract calls in ONE ledger Intent) -> FAILED: Transaction submission error | sdk-scoped batch (one transaction, one segment per call, state threaded) -> OK

cells.label: M1 — mixed-colour composition: two colours move atomically in ONE transaction (FR-107)
cells.points: shape "sdk-scoped batch (one transaction, one segment per call, state threaded)"; both effects observed after a single transaction id

cells.label: Invariant: `custody[c] == AA_A[c] + AA_B[c]` for all four colours, after EVERY step
cells.points: asserted in `assertAll` after all fourteen rows, per colour, between two independently maintained mechanisms (contract `balances` map vs pooled zswap coin / ledger-kernel unshielded balance)

cells.label: FR-105 exactness: `balances.size() == accounts x 4` with ZERO unaccounted keys, after every step
cells.points: every key in raw ledger state reproduced by the contract's own pure `balanceKey` circuit; a cell moving that the step did not name is a step failure
